Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    bool isPerfectSquare(int num) {
        int i = 1; // i: 表示奇数, 1是用于下面循环的奇数初始值
        while (num > 0)
        {
            num -= i;
            i += 2;
        }
        if (num == 0) return true;
        return false;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int num = 14;
    auto res = sol.isPerfectSquare(num);
    cout << (res ? "True" : "False") << endl;

    return 0;
}
